nodes.rationale: Stays a card; apply the floor/ceiling and return-focus rule to both cards.

nodes.rationale: Confirmed right; no report suggests removing it.

nodes.label: Deviation: Launch at login stays
nodes.rationale: The spec's nine-row list omitted it by mistake; nobody decided to remove it.

nodes.label: Deviation: ResumeNotifier deleted, card instead
nodes.rationale: Part 1 said notification, Part 4 says card; the card needs no permission.

nodes.label: Bridge grace and research window rows removed
nodes.norm_label: bridge grace and research window rows removed
nodes.rationale: Both keep their pref keys and defaults (180 s, 1200 s) so anyone who set them is unaffected; the rows are simply not shown.

nodes.label: Cutaway rename
nodes.rationale: Product, folder, project, targets and env vars become Cutaway; store files and Prefs suite are not renamed because that would strand existing users' data.

nodes.label: Daily-goal ring removed
nodes.rationale: The hero shows today's time and money; 'enough today?' is a Stats question; pref key left unread.

nodes.label: Edits leave a trace
nodes.rationale: WorkSession.isAdjusted, DayTotal.adjustedSeconds, CSV adjusted_hours column, Stats pencil glyph; trimming a day deletes real sessions and is not flagged because nothing was invented.

nodes.label: Forgotten-pause resume
nodes.rationale: Modes off / ask / auto, default ask; a manual pause is sacred backwards, time before a resume is never billed; 45 s anchor signal, 15 min ask cooldown.

nodes.label: Gate not memo
nodes.rationale: While a project is selected its list replaces the global anchor list; empty means use the global list; a colour pass in Resolve cannot land on the wrong invoice.

nodes.label: Menu-bar-first
nodes.rationale: The pill and its panel are the app; the Timer tab is removed and the main window becomes Stats; zero state and the Accessibility offer move into the panel because it is what a new user opens first.

nodes.label: Native where nobody looks twice
nodes.rationale: Settings, ProjectSheet, delete sheet and EditDaySheet become standard SwiftUI Form with system controls; custom stays on pill, panel and Stats where the identity lives.

nodes.label: Never two cards on screen
nodes.rationale: Idle warning and resume prompt cannot coincide by state (manual-paused vs recording) but a test pins it.

nodes.label: Part 4 UI fit to the owner's day
nodes.norm_label: part 4 ui fit to the owner's day
nodes.rationale: Minimal means fewer surfaces and fewer knobs, not fewer pixels.

nodes.label: Pre-ticked app picker
nodes.rationale: The create sheet starts with every global anchor ticked so the normal case needs zero clicks; a narrow job is an untick.

nodes.label: Real app icons via NSWorkspace
nodes.rationale: Icons come from installed apps via NSWorkspace; not installed shows SF Symbol app.dashed at 50%; no third-party artwork is shipped.

nodes.label: Reclaim offer removed
nodes.rationale: Away time beyond the bridge is gone; the day editor covers the rare case, with a trace; the session-close half of the bridge-idle fix stays because that was the bug.

nodes.label: Accessibility optional
nodes.rationale: Lets Cutaway read Resolve's window title; without it detection falls back to the scripting API and manual switching.

nodes.label: Anchors
nodes.rationale: Resolve and the Adobe toolchain prove a work block and start the clock, but only while the user is providing input.

nodes.label: CSV export
nodes.rationale: One row per worked day plus a summary block; the canonical hand-off.

nodes.label: Cutaway
nodes.rationale: Automatic time tracking for DaVinci Resolve editors; the timer starts when you start editing and stops when you stop.

nodes.label: Everything is editable and says so
nodes.norm_label: everything is editable and says so
nodes.rationale: Edit day, Add day, pencil on the day, adjusted_hours in the CSV.

nodes.label: Fixed budget mode
nodes.rationale: Burn-down with amber/red warnings and a pace forecast.

nodes.label: Forgotten pauses
nodes.rationale: After about 45 s of anchor editing while paused the app asks Are you working?; resume never bills backwards; browsers never trigger it.

nodes.label: Idle threshold
nodes.rationale: Long unattended renders pause the clock; raise the threshold deliberately.

nodes.label: Projects follow Resolve
nodes.rationale: Asks Resolve which project is open and switches attribution; unseen projects are created on the spot.

nodes.label: Research window
nodes.rationale: Default 20 minutes after the last anchor activity.

nodes.label: Satellites
nodes.rationale: Browser, Claude/ChatGPT, email, Dropbox sustain the clock only inside the research window.

nodes.label: The bridge
nodes.rationale: Quick detours are forgiven retroactively if you return within the grace period (default 3 minutes).

nodes.label: Two questions never at once
nodes.rationale: Still working? before an idle pause and Are you working? during a manual pause; small cards that never steal focus.

nodes.label: Sacred pause
nodes.rationale: Manual pause (Opt-Cmd-P) and system sleep are hard boundaries; time behind a pause is never billed, not even by the bridge.

nodes.label: Under-billing rule
nodes.rationale: Every rule resolves ambiguity toward under-billing because an invoice is only worth something if every line on it is defensible.

nodes.label: Colour vision check
nodes.rationale: Deuteranopia: pill states are shape-coded (filled dot, two bars, empty); macOS has no .trait audit.

nodes.label: Increase Contrast and Reduce Transparency check
nodes.norm_label: increase contrast and reduce transparency check
nodes.rationale: The app reads NSWorkspace.accessibilityDisplayShouldIncreaseContrast, not the appearance name, because macOS collapses accessibility appearance names; this cost a broken release once.

nodes.label: Keyboard end-to-end check
nodes.rationale: Ctrl-F8 focus ring, Return opens, Escape closes and returns focus, Cmd-Q quits, right-click menu.

nodes.label: Light appearance check
nodes.rationale: The status bar follows the system appearance, not the app's forced dark scheme, so the pill is the one surface that can be illegible for a Light-mode user.

nodes.label: VoiceOver spot check
nodes.rationale: The pill says state, duration and project once; day rows state date, hours and amount; auto-switch is announced.

nodes.label: Liquid Glass
nodes.rationale: Glass belongs on the floating navigation layer (toolbars, sidebars, popover shells, menus), never in content and never glass-on-glass; popovers adopt it automatically on the 26 SDK.

nodes.label: NSStatusItem plus NSPopover
nodes.rationale: Mainstream choice for a rich panel; MenuBarExtra ties icon existence to the scene and can leave the app unable to launch under Tahoe's Allow in Menu Bar toggle.

nodes.label: Tahoe transparent menu bar
nodes.rationale: Block-drawn images are not tinted reliably and contentTintColor disables template tinting; working pattern is a bitmap-backed template glyph plus pre-coloured non-template state copies.

nodes.label: Bundle metadata gaps
nodes.rationale: No app category, empty copyright, legacy .icns icon.

nodes.label: Per-view forced dark
nodes.rationale: preferredColorScheme(.dark) in 7 views; fragile; per-view forcing is what App Review rejects.

nodes.label: Tally light pill
nodes.rationale: Green recording, amber paused, red no project.

nodes.label: Accessibility manual checks
nodes.rationale: What cannot be automated: macOS has no audit type for it, or XCUITest would measure event delivery rather than the app.

nodes.label: Forced dark appearance
nodes.rationale: Apple calls dark-only 'rare cases' (Stocks); the sanctioned mechanism is NSApp.appearance = .darkAqua at app level; per-view forcing produced App Review rejections (Klarity).

nodes.label: Icon jail
nodes.rationale: A legacy-only .icns icon is shrunk onto a grey squircle on macOS 26; Xcode derives the 14-15 icon from the Icon Composer file.

nodes.label: Premium Mac utility traits
nodes.rationale: One typeface at 2-3 weights, colour reserved for meaning, hairline depth, sub-500 ms motion with sound only at reward moments, AppKit-exact behaviour.

nodes.label: Rec: Build with the 26 SDK and audit the popover shell
nodes.norm_label: rec: build with the 26 sdk and audit the popover shell
nodes.rationale: Remove any visual-effect view behind popover content; taller controls clip hard-coded heights. Effort S.

nodes.label: Rec: Decide appearance at app level
nodes.norm_label: rec: decide appearance at app level
nodes.rationale: HIG rare-cases rule; App Review rejects half-done light modes; verify Increase Contrast x Reduce Transparency and 26.1 Clear/Tinted. Effort S.

nodes.label: Rec: Dev hygiene throwaway bundle IDs
nodes.norm_label: rec: dev hygiene throwaway bundle ids
nodes.rationale: ControlCenter TCC ledger can block a bundle ID launched by other apps; hotkey fallback for Allow in Menu Bar. Effort S.

nodes.label: Rec: Harden the status glyph for the transparent menu bar
nodes.norm_label: rec: harden the status glyph for the transparent menu bar
nodes.rationale: Tahoe tinting failures; bitmap-backed template for idle, pre-coloured copies for tally states, never contentTintColor. Effort S.

nodes.label: Rec: Motion budget
nodes.rationale: Transitions at most 250 ms; one 500 ms spring for start/stop; gated on Reduce Motion. Effort S.

nodes.label: Rec: Optional 26-only footer glass
nodes.rationale: The footer is the one on-doctrine spot for a GlassEffectContainer; none in hero or rows. Effort M.

nodes.label: Rec: performAccessibilityAudit per panel state
nodes.rationale: Apple's audit definition; feeds the Accessibility Nutrition Label. Effort S.

nodes.label: Rec: Rebuild the app icon in Icon Composer
nodes.norm_label: rec: rebuild the app icon in icon composer
nodes.rationale: Legacy .icns lands in icon jail on 26; one file yields both looks. Effort M.

nodes.label: Rec: Restrain the cyan
nodes.rationale: Things/Raycast pattern and Apple's tint-for-meaning rule; hairlines over shadows. Effort S.

nodes.label: Rec: Tally light non-colour twin
nodes.rationale: HIG: convey state with more than colour alone. Effort S.

nodes.label: Contradiction: Forced dark
nodes.rationale: Kept, but must be one app-level decision surviving Increase Contrast x Reduce Transparency and 26.1 Clear/Tinted.

nodes.label: Plan #5 App-level appearance decision
nodes.rationale: NSApp.appearance = .darkAqua once, documented as a media-instrument exception; remove 7 per-view forces. S.

nodes.norm_label: plan #6 icon composer icon and metadata
nodes.rationale: Legacy .icns is icon jail on 26; missing metadata reads amateur. M.

nodes.label: Art. 26 MWSTG invoice fields
nodes.rationale: Swiss VAT Act mandatory fields: supplier name/location with VAT number, recipient, supply period, nature/extent, consideration, rate and tax amount.

nodes.label: Billing status
nodes.rationale: Timing: Not billable / Billable / Billed / Paid; Bonsai: Non-billable / Unbilled / Billed.

nodes.label: CHF 0.05 rounding
nodes.rationale: Cash rounds to 5 Rappen; formula x20, round, /20; convention total to 0.05.

nodes.label: Day rate
nodes.rationale: Post-production day = 10 h, 1.5x after 8 h, 2x after 12; IATSE Local 700 sets 8 h minimum.

nodes.label: EU reverse charge
nodes.rationale: Art. 44/196 services from a non-established supplier: sequential number, both VAT IDs, literal mention Reverse charge.

nodes.label: ImageRenderer to PDF
nodes.rationale: SwiftUI ImageRenderer into a CGContext PDF keeps text vector with zero dependencies; multi-page by mutating renderer.content per page.

nodes.label: Lock on invoice
nodes.rationale: Entries locked once invoiced; deleting the invoice unmarks them (Harvest, Clockify).

nodes.label: Minimum billing units
nodes.rationale: 4-hour minimum is standard for hourly gigs; half days up to 4 h.

nodes.label: Per-entry rounding raw kept
nodes.rationale: Harvest/Toggl/EARLY round per entry before totalling and keep the exact value; rounding is a tool setting, not an editor norm.

nodes.label: Swiss QR-bill IG 2.3
nodes.rationale: SIX Implementation Guidelines v2.3 since Nov 2025: amount two decimals, CHF/EUR only, structured addresses, 148x105 mm payment part plus 62x105 mm receipt, Helvetica 6-10 pt.

nodes.label: Swiss VAT threshold
nodes.rationale: Liable at CHF 100 000 worldwide turnover; below, no VAT line unless opted in; rates 8.1 / 2.6 / 3.8 %.

nodes.label: Invoice arithmetic round once then sum
nodes.norm_label: invoice arithmetic round once then sum

nodes.label: Clockify rounding trap
nodes.rationale: Invoices round hours to two decimals but reports do not, so 20 min bills $33.00 vs $33.33; totals that disagree are a top complaint.

nodes.label: Invoicing complaints
nodes.rationale: Export-and-rebuild loops, totals that disagree, no invoiced/paid state, lost billable time, pricing shocks; all argue for a local, boring, correct invoice inside Cutaway.

nodes.label: Rec: Client entity with tax mode
nodes.norm_label: rec: client entity with tax mode
nodes.rationale: Name, address, country, VAT ID, currency, rate, terms; tax mode from country plus owner registration; CHF totals to 0.05. Effort M.

nodes.label: Rec: Day rate and minimum units
nodes.norm_label: rec: day rate and minimum units
nodes.rationale: Per project hourly / day (N h, OT multiplier) / budget; minimum applied as its own line, worked vs booked visible. Effort M.

nodes.label: Rec: Invoice PDF from a period
nodes.norm_label: rec: invoice pdf from a period
nodes.rationale: Invoice record INV-YYYY-NNNN, issue/due date, currency, client and Art. 26 supplier blocks, lines Detailed / by day / Summary, rendered via ImageRenderer; data source is the existing period picker and CSV summary. Effort M.

nodes.label: Rec: Manual invoice lines
nodes.rationale: Free-form Service/Product lines; deposit as a negative line; no expense module (YAGNI). Effort S.

nodes.label: Rec: QR-bill on CHF and EUR invoices
nodes.norm_label: rec: qr-bill on chf and eur invoices
nodes.rationale: IBAN/QR-IBAN plus structured address in settings; SCOR reference from the invoice number as Harvie does; payload per IG 2.3; QR via dagronf/QRCode with Swiss cross. Effort M.

nodes.label: Rec: Rounding per project
nodes.rationale: Off / nearest / down at 6 or 15 min per session before totalling; both columns reported; one assert: sum of rounded equals invoice total. Effort S.

nodes.label: Rec: Unbilled view and lock
nodes.rationale: billingStatus unbilled/invoiced/paid on sessions, unbilled total per project in the popover, lock on invoice. Effort S.

nodes.label: Under-billing honesty explicit
nodes.rationale: Cutaway never inflates time: rounding opt-in defaulting to nearest or down, raw seconds kept beside the rounded value, manual edits flagged adjusted_hours, minimums and day rates as booked-not-worked lines.

nodes.label: Rec: PDF project report
nodes.rationale: 8/10 competitors export PDF; CSV-only reads unfinished for invoicing. Effort M.

nodes.label: Rec: Rounding rules per project
nodes.rationale: Hours, Toggl, Timemator, Tyme offer it; always down to honour under-billing. Effort S.

nodes.norm_label: plan #12 invoice pdf from a period
nodes.rationale: CSV-only reads unfinished; 8/10 export PDF. M.

nodes.label: Plan #13 Client entity and tax mode
nodes.norm_label: plan #13 client entity and tax mode
nodes.rationale: Legal correctness for a Swiss freelancer with EU/US/CO clients. M.

nodes.label: Plan #14 Swiss QR-bill
nodes.rationale: The premium signal for the owner's market. M.

nodes.label: Plan #15 Billing status and lock on invoice
nodes.norm_label: plan #15 billing status and lock on invoice
nodes.rationale: Kills the top two invoicing complaints. S.

nodes.label: Plan #16 Rounding per project
nodes.rationale: Always down or nearest, raw seconds kept; honesty-compatible. S.

nodes.label: Plan #17 Day rate minimum units manual lines
nodes.norm_label: plan #17 day rate minimum units manual lines
nodes.rationale: What editors actually bill. M.

nodes.label: AXObserver notifications
nodes.rationale: AXObserverAddNotification on kAXFocusedWindowChanged and kAXTitleChanged replaces title polling; Karabiner re-subscribes on every focus change.

nodes.label: Timer tolerance
nodes.rationale: Apple: at least 10% of the interval; repeating timers do not drift; dispatch_timer_strict should be avoided.

nodes.label: 1 Hz polling engine
nodes.rationale: One Timer at 1 Hz, tolerance 0.5 s, polls frontmost and idle; adequate with two cheap upgrades.

nodes.label: Rec: Event-driven loop
nodes.rationale: Keep the 1 Hz permission-free idle read; app switches via didActivateApplicationNotification; Resolve titles via AXObserver with 5 s poll fallback. Effort M, no new permission.

nodes.label: Rec: Timer tolerance and event-driven frontmost detection
nodes.norm_label: rec: timer tolerance and event-driven frontmost detection
nodes.rationale: tolerance 0.1+, stop the timer when no session runs, didActivateApplicationNotification; verify 0 idle wakes with timerfires/powermetrics. Effort S.

nodes.label: Plan #9 Event-driven detection
nodes.rationale: didActivateApplicationNotification, AXObserver, keep 1 Hz idle read, stop the timer when nothing can record. M.

nodes.label: CutawayCore package
nodes.rationale: At 5.5k lines the only structural win: one UI-free SwiftPM package (session math, idle rules, Resolve bridge protocol, export) testable via swift test without AppKit.

nodes.label: Developer ID

nodes.label: Accessibility permission
nodes.rationale: All strong trackers need it to read window titles; Apple's own alert says the app can control your Mac, so the in-app explanation must pre-empt that; prompt suppressed for sandboxed apps.

nodes.label: After Effects DoScript route

nodes.label: Automation permission

nodes.label: Display-sleep assertion presence rule
nodes.rationale: Apps holding kIOPMAssertionTypePreventUserIdleDisplaySleep (players, meeting apps) are visible system-wide; Timing turns idle detection off when the frontmost app prevents the screen going dark.

nodes.label: Idle threshold defaults
nodes.rationale: Timing 3, ActivityWatch 3, RescueTime 5, Rize 5 minutes; idle counts from last input so the stretch is removed retroactively.

nodes.label: Prompt floor and ceiling
nodes.rationale: Timing asks only after 5 min and never after 10 h; focus returns to the previous app.

nodes.label: Resolve Tier 1 / Tier 2 detection
nodes.rationale: Tier 1 scripting API is Studio-only since 19.1; Tier 2 window title with Accessibility; Cutaway's split is right.

nodes.label: Rule-based matching with dwell
nodes.rationale: Timemator rules carry a dwell time to prevent false triggering; Timing offers a title-contains rule on project creation.

nodes.label: Out of scope
nodes.rationale: Per-project satellites, auto-switch by app, Adobe project names, bundled logos, billing arithmetic, restyling pill/panel/Stats.
